thread.title: Roku Stock Jumps On Upgrade For Ad-Supported Streaming

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Roku Stock Jumps On Upgrade For Ad-Supported Streaming
text:
Streaming video platform Roku ( ROKU ) is developing a potentially lucrative business in advertiser-supported internet video through its Roku Channel service, a Wall Street analyst said in a report released Tuesday.
X "The rapid adoption of the Roku Channel gives us incremental confidence in the channel's ability to garner viewership on other platforms, such as Samsung (smart TVs), allowing Roku to monetize a broader portion of the OTT (over-the-top) ecosystem than we had previously assumed was possible," Oppenheimer analyst Jason Helfstein said.
Helfstein upgraded Roku stock to outperform from perform and set a price target of 50.
Roku shares jumped 5.2% to close at 45.54 on the stock market today . Roku went public in September at $14 a share. It climbed as high as 58.80 on Dec. 19.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Roku Channel Just 9 Months Old Los Gatos, Calif.-based Roku provides a popular platform for viewing subscription video-on-demand services like Netflix ( NFLX ), Hulu and Amazon ( AMZN ) Prime Video. It also offers free, ad-supported streaming video, including its own Roku Channel.
"We believe the Roku Channel is 0.63% of domestic time spent on Roku's platform or the 12th most-watched app by viewing hours, which represents a 9-million-hour monthly run-rate only nine months post-launch," Helfstein said.
Roku sells set-top boxes and dongles for accessing internet video. It also offers a smart TV operating system to television manufacturers.
In streaming hardware, it competes with Amazon, Apple ( AAPL ) and Alphabet 's ( GOOGL ) Google, which are also pushing their own video services.
Roku ended the March quarter with 20.8 million active accounts, up 1.5 million from the December quarter. It monetizes its platform and user base mostly through advertising sales. Plus, it gets a share of sales from pay-per-view and subscription video-on-demand services.
